scope: Actual final7 dependency-patched local production build. Sequential quiet measurements after all QA browser and HTTP suites. Synthetic isolated database, providers blocked; not production or field metrics.

method.interactionNote: Maximum observed EventTiming duration from one scripted interaction; this is a lab sample, not field INP. 0 means no qualifying >=16 ms entry was observed.
method.compressionNote: gzip level 9 / Brotli quality 11 sizes are computed from decoded source; they are potential CDN transfer sizes, not claims about deployed encoding.

method.coordinatedOmission: Latency does not include time waiting before a worker can issue its next request. This test measures local saturation, not a fixed arrival-rate production SLA.
method.databaseAndAppLocation: same host; no CDN, serverless cold start or internet RTT
